_doc: 1.10.0 (de-robotization slice 1, T2b, 2026-08-17) — the open is
authored per seat instead of as one number, and the 3-bet gains a
second rung. Measured over 4,000 hands before this change, this pack
opened 3.0bb with share 1.000 from all eight opening seats, and 82% of
those opens came from seats whose canonical open is 3.0. A seat-blind
mix would therefore have put 2.5bb opens under the gun, which is the
wrong fix; the ladder here (3.0 early and in the small blind, 2.5 from
the hijack round) is this repo's own model of a realistic full-ring
open, in `scenarios._OPEN_SIZE`. This is the disciplined reg, so the
deviation is the smallest of the three regulars: 0.90 on the seat's
canonical size, 0.10 off it.
The 3-bet was 3.5x with share 1.000. Its absolute size already varied,
but only because the open it answered did — a detector reading the
ratio saw a constant. It now mixes 3.5 and 3.0.
No 4-bet mix: 27 four-bets per 4,000 hands, and the multiplier already
sits exactly on the 2.4 grading cap, so any mix could only lower it.
That is a real change to how the pack denies odds bought for almost no
observable variety.
Every rung obeys a grading bound rather than taste. Opens stay at or
under 3.0 because above it hero's vs-4-bet spot is refused outright
(`grade_map_preflop._STD_OPEN_CAP`); 3-bet rungs stay at or under 3.5
for the same reason at the vs-3-bet spot. The ledger
(`docs/ai-dlc/ledger/phase3-derobotization.md`) carries the full
decision table and the realised histograms.
[UNVERIFIED] — the weights within each seat. No committed source gives
a population distribution of open sizes by seat at low-stakes full
ring. They are deliberately low-entropy, so the pack still has a modal
size a regular would recognise as its own.
1.9.0 (de-robotization slice 1, T5, 2026-08-17, second review rework) —
`cbet_wet` gains a 0.33 at 14%. Before it, no regular and not the maniac
authored a third-pot bet on a wet flop, so that bet named `station or fish`
outright. A cheap stab on a coordinated board with a range that mostly gave
up is an ordinary reg play, so this is a realism gain as much as a tell
removal. It costs 4.9% of this pack's bluff mass at that node, through the
F2 joint law: a pack's own size mix scales how often it bluffs.
The share is 14% rather than a third of the class's requirement because the
nit takes none — see its 1.9.0 entry, which has the measurement. The
quantity the tell depends on is the CLASS average, and this pack and the
lag carry all of it between them.
1.8.0 (de-robotization slice 1, T5, 2026-08-16) — postflop bet sizes are
re-weighted so this seat is no longer identifiable by size alone. The
realised bucket table for the whole roster is in the ticket ledger
(`docs/ai-dlc/ledger/phase3-derobotization.md`) rather than here: three
reviewers measured it three ways and got three answers, because the share
depends on whether clamped and off-grid bets are counted. The ledger states
the definition once; a per-pack copy of a number nobody can reproduce is
worse than no number.
`river_value` had NO medium size at all (0.75/1.0) and now carries one. That
hole was most of the reason this pack read LARGE-heavy: a half-pot river bet
is ordinary and the pack could not make one. The `raise` block was widened
at the same time and that part was wasted — see the ledger; no bot can reach
it, because a seat facing a bet is never the aggressor and only the
aggressor reads a node override.
Every value stays on the grader's recognised grid {0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0,
1.5}; nothing is jittered continuously. No 1.5 is authored here — an
overbet would fire on bluffs as readily as on value, because the engine
draws size independently of hand strength on purpose (theory contract F14),
and `_bluff_size_factor` actually favours the larger size on a bluff cell.
[UNVERIFIED] — no committed source in this repo gives a population
distribution of bet sizes at low-stakes full ring. See the calling
station's 1.7.0 entry for the one sourced observation this is anchored on.
1.7.0 (de-robotization slice 1, 2026-08-15, review rework) — `vs_rfi`,
`vs_limpers` and `vs_3bet` are answered PER SEAT instead of identically from
all nine. Facing a raise, the fold runs 75.30% in the big blind, 82.58% on
the cutoff and button, 85.21% early and 87.75% in the small blind — the
worst seat, which pays more than the big blind and does not close. It was a
The big blind is 1.42x the button by continue rate. The first draft of this
slice made them EQUAL (20.17 against 20.15) by spreading the old flat number
symmetrically around itself; the shape is now derived first and scaled to the
held aggregate afterwards. The cutoff and button paid for it, which is right —
that seat has to cold-call or 3-bet rather than close for a price.
The CO/BTN tier that cold-called AQo, ATo and KJo 100% of the time is softened
to 0.85. It was named in this slice's own ledger as a defect the statistical
gates cannot see, and it sat in the band that reaches that node most.
[UNVERIFIED] — no committed source in this repo covers per-seat DEFENCE
frequencies (R9-SEATPROV governs `unopened` ladders only). These targets are
authored to a realistic per-seat SHAPE and scaled to the pack's pre-slice
measured aggregate; the aggregate is the provenance, the shape is judgement.
1.5.0 (R9-DEFENCE-a T1, 2026-08-02) — ONE new postflop number,
`line_sensitivity`: 0.5 (directional fit seed, tag tier). It is READ by
`personas_postflop._line_scaled`, which scales the facing-node CALL and
RAISE merits by `exp(-λ·line)` where `λ = _LINE_DELTA · line_sensitivity`,
so a tag folds more to a persistent hostile line.
1.4.0 (N-LOGIT, 2026-08-02) — ONE new postflop number, `continue_ref`:
0.6, a FROZEN copy of today's effective `call_looseness`. It is the anchor
the facing-node RAISE merit is divided by, so the raise:call odds stop
moving when `call_looseness` is tuned. At the authored value the ratio is
exactly 1.0 and play is bit-identical. NEVER re-sync it with
`call_looseness` — that restores the old coupling and deletes the feature.
1.3.0 (N-TAGWIDTH, 2026-07-31) — the UTG / HJ / CO / BTN / SB `unopened`
nodes are TRIMMED toward the per-seat RFI bands in the repo's committed
provenance doc (docs/ai-dlc/research/rfi-seat-provenance.md). Still
emitted: the same spec regenerates them and the same proving gate holds.
UTG1 / UTG2 / LJ / BB are untouched, and the pair band stays byte-identical
at every seat.
that seat is a recomposition, its suited tail paying for ATo+/KQo)
BTN lands inside its band (30-45) and SB inside its own (15-36). HJ and CO
stay over theirs because the untouched LJ (27.90) plus the monotone ladder
floors them at ~28; the early seats stay over because the per-seat target
and the frozen §5 PFR floor cannot both be met there — an escalated
contract conflict. Both are argued with numbers in the spec's `_doc`.
At the four LATE seats this deliberately walks back part of 1.2.0's suited
push (owner-adjudicated): the junk suited tail is retired and the freed
width goes back into the standard offsuit block, so the button now opens
A2o+, K9o+, Q9o+, J9o+, T9o (K8o/Q8o/J8o/T8o/98o at 0.5) instead of
K5o+/Q7o+/J8o+ alongside 32s. 29 classes leave the corpus, none is added.
UTG is recomposed rather than trimmed: its suited tail (A6s-A2s, K7s, Q9s,
Q8s, J8s, T8s, 87s) goes and ATo/KQo come back at full weight.
1.2.0 (N-TAGCOMP, 2026-07-31) — all nine `unopened` nodes REPLACED. They
are now EMITTED, not hand-authored: the curve spec is
content/personas/ladders/tag.unopened.json and `cd backend && python -m
tools.rr_emit ../content/personas/ladders/tag.unopened.json` regenerates
exactly the mixes below (proved by backend/tests/test_rr_emit.py).
Nothing else in this pack changed: vs_limpers / vs_rfi / vs_3bet / vs_4bet
are byte-identical, and the pair band is byte-identical at every seat
(class-for-class and weight-for-weight, pinned by
tests/test_personas.py::test_tagcomp_pair_band_unchanged_preservation).
This is a COMPOSITION swap at constant width (theory finding T-M2), NOT a
widen or a trim — the tag was playing its width offsuit, which is the
inverse of the archetype's shape. Per seat, combo-weighted:
The TOTAL never RISES at any seat and falls by at most 0.4525pp (HJ);
seat-average 34.0204 -> 33.8529. The width is held rather than spent
because the measured population PFR leaves ~1.7 sd of headroom over its
§5 floor — the band, its provenance triple, the 10-seed before/after sweep
and the authoring rules all live in the spec's `_doc`, which is the single
place this slice states them; nothing is restated or re-derived here.
